items.name: Yogurt, Fruit and Granola
method: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with granola and frozen berries. The berries thaw slightly as you eat.

items.name: Peanut Butter and Jam on Toast
method: Toast the bread.
Spread peanut butter on one slice, jam on the other. Or both on both.

items.name: Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, greek yoghurt, chocolate powder and chia seeds in a jar or bowl.
Add enough milk or water to just cover, stir well.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with frozen berries and eat.

items.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
method: Season chicken with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon. Pan-fry in olive oil for 4 minutes each side.
Rest 3 minutes, then slice.
Shred the lettuce, toss with dressing.
Warm the wrap briefly. Fill with lettuce, sliced chicken and shaved parmesan. Roll and serve.

items.name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
method: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes. Add green beans for the last 4 minutes. Drain and cool.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar and mustard for the dressing.
Arrange potatoes, beans, halved tomatoes, olives and tuna on a plate.
Top with egg halves and drizzle with dressing.

items.name: Halloumi and Roast Veg Pitta
method: Slice pepper, courgette and red onion. Toss with olive oil and oregano.
Roast at 200C for 15 minutes.
Slice halloumi 1cm thick. Fry in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes each side until golden.
Warm the pitta, split open. Spread with hummus, stuff with veg and halloumi.

items.name: Egg Fried Rice
method: Beat the eggs. Heat half the oil in a wok, add eggs and scramble quickly. Remove.
Add the remaining oil, fry minced garlic and white parts of spring onion for 30 seconds.
Add rice, break it up. Stir-fry 2-3 minutes.
Add peas, soy sauce and sesame oil. Return the egg. Toss. Top with green spring onion.

items.name: Minestrone Soup
method: Finely chop onion, carrot and celery. Fry in olive oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add crushed garlic, cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes and stock, simmer 15 minutes.
Add drained beans and pasta, cook until pasta is tender (about 8 minutes).
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve topped with grated parmesan.

items.name: Lamb Kebab Rolls
method: Preheat oven to 200C. Cut the potato into 1cm batons, toss with olive oil and the gunpowder spice mix. Roast for 30 minutes.
Thinly slice one shallot and put in cider vinegar to pickle while everything else cooks.
Mix the lamb mince with the kofta spice mix, black pepper and a pinch of salt. Shape into small sausages and roast for 12 minutes.
For the green chutney: blitz the mint, fresh coriander, olive oil, lemon juice and the second shallot in a small blender.
For the yoghurt sauce: mix greek yoghurt with grated cucumber, crushed garlic and a squeeze of lemon.
Chop the lettuce into strips and cube the tomato.
Char the tortillas on a dry hot pan.
Assemble: tortilla, green chutney, yoghurt sauce, kofta, potatoes, lettuce, tomato, pickled shallots. Roll up.

items.name: Pad Kra Pao
method: Cook the jasmine rice per packet instructions.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the sliced shallot and garlic and fry for 3 minutes.
Add the sliced chilli (deseed first if you want less heat) and cook for another minute.
Crank up the heat. Add the minced pork, breaking it into small bits and letting it crisp.
Add sugar, fish sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and oyster sauce. Stir-fry another minute.
Deglaze with the chicken stock - it should cook off quickly on the high heat.
Add the basil and stir-fry until wilted. Serve over the rice.

items.name: Wrap Pizza
method: Preheat oven to 180C.
Place the wraps on a baking tray and crisp in the oven for 3-4 minutes.
Spread passata thinly over each wrap.
Sprinkle with grated cheese, then add toppings. Flex to what you have: ham, chorizo, sweetcorn, peppers, olives, mushrooms - anything goes.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and the edges are crisp.

items.name: Thai Red or Green Curry
method: Cook the jasmine rice per packet instructions.
Heat the oil in a wok or pan over medium-high heat. Fry the sliced onion for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add the sliced chilli and diced chicken. Stir-fry until the chicken is browned all over.
Stir in the curry paste (red or green - both work) and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add the baby corn, sliced peppers and mangetout. Cover and simmer for 5-6 minutes until the veg is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the curry over the rice.

items.name: Chicken Fajitas
method: Chop half the onion. Heat the oil in a pan and fry for 3-4 minutes until softening.
Slice the peppers. Add to the pan and cook 2-3 minutes.
Slice the chicken thinly. Push the veg aside, add chicken and brown all over.
Stir in the fajita spice mix. Cook down 2-3 minutes, adding a splash of water if it looks dry.
Meanwhile, finely chop the tomato and the remaining half onion. Mix with a good pinch of flakey salt and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Slice the avocado.
Warm the wraps briefly. Fill with the chicken and peppers, cheese, tomato-onion mix, avocado slices and a spoon of salsa.
Serve with tortilla chips on the side.

items.name: Burgers and Chips
method: Preheat oven to 220C. Spread the frozen chips on a baking tray and bake for 20-25 minutes, turning halfway.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high. Cook the burger patty for 4-5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Lay the cheese slice on top of the patty in the last minute so it melts.
Slice the tomato and wash the lettuce.
Toast the bun cut-side down in the pan for a minute to warm.
Build the burger: bottom bun, ketchup, lettuce, tomato slices, patty with cheese, top bun.
Serve with the chips.

items.name: Sausage and Mash
method: Peel the potatoes and cut into chunks. Boil in salted water for 15-18 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, cook the sausages: grill or oven-bake at 200C for 20 minutes, turning halfway. Pan-frying also works.
Steam or microwave the frozen peas for 3-4 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash with a splash of milk and plenty of black pepper.
Make the gravy: mix the granules with 200ml boiling water (adjust to preferred thickness).
Plate the mash, top with sausages, add peas on the side and pour the gravy over.

items.name: Chicken Pesto Pasta
method: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions.
Meanwhile, grill or oven-cook the chicken sausages at 200C for 15 minutes, turning halfway.
Slice the pepper and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Add the frozen peas to the pasta water for the last 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta and peas, return to the pan.
Stir the pesto through to coat.
Slice the cooked sausages. Top the pasta with the sausages, cherry tomatoes and sliced pepper.
Finish with the grated cheese.

items.name: Chicken Katsu
method: Cook the rice per packet instructions.
Bake the breaded chicken breast at 200C per pack instructions (usually 18-20 minutes).
Warm the katsu sauce in a small pan over low heat.
Steam the broccoli, sweetcorn and peas for 3-4 minutes.
Slice the cooked chicken. Serve on the rice with the veg alongside and the katsu sauce drizzled over.

items.name: Soup and Crusty Roll
method: Heat the soup on the hob or in the microwave per pack instructions.
Warm the roll in the oven for a few minutes if you like.
Serve soup with the roll for dipping.
